normalization: Set the first and last energy-group boundaries to exact 1.0e-5 and 1.0e7 in the copied upstream materials.py before importing it to generate mgxs.h5.
root_cause: The upstream materials.py constructed the energy-group boundaries with np.logspace(-5, 7, 8), whose first endpoint could be represented as 9.999999999999999e-06 in one environment.
scope: This resolves MGXS byte consistency for this normalized repeatability workflow. The runs remain smoke-budget only; it does not certify the benchmark or validate a QUBO-to-material mapping.
